title: Rift Backlash
next_chapter_hook: The ink of those four characters had not yet dried, yet Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill climb from his tailbone to the back of his neck—someone was secretly watching him, and this person knew all his secrets.

text.content: Three hundred li outside the Tianqing Sect, an inconspicuous abandoned village. In the dilapidated ancestral hall, Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a dust-covered meditation cushion, before him spread an incomplete ancient tome. His face was haggard, his temples tinged with gray, making him look like a down-and-out wandering cultivator. The feigned death performance three days ago had fooled everyone—except her.

The characters on the Tianji Record Fragment flickered faintly—that was the sign that Mister Mo's remnant soul had not yet fully awakened. Chen Ji stared at those half-visible talismanic symbols, his fingertips gently stroking the paper's surface. After the feigned death, his Heavenly Fate Value had plummeted to three hundred and twenty points, leaving only one hundred and eighty points of margin before the critical threshold Mister Mo had warned him about. Every point of consumption felt like a knife carving into his heart.

dialogue.content: Mister Mo, you sleep so peacefully. This junior here is completely at his wit's end.

text.content: A withered old chuckle echoed from the depths of the ancient tome, Mister Mo's voice drifting out like gossamer: "Little ghost, you think this old man enjoys watching you make a mess of things? Feigned death to escape is indeed a clever plan, but you exposed the aura of the Tianji Record Fragment—those vultures scenting blood have already made their move." Before his words even finished, outside the ancestral hall, several crows on withered branches suddenly startled into flight.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his divine sense quietly extending outward. Around the abandoned village, at least three auras were patrolling—one carrying the Xuanwu Sect's distinctive thick earth-attribute force, one emanating the demonic path's unique yin malevolent energy, and another... extremely subtle, like the aura of imperial court shadow guards. Three factions, all arriving at this exact location simultaneously.

choice.prompt: Three factions closing in simultaneously, Chen Ji needed to make a choice before being exposed: take the risk to contact Su Qingyao in advance, or first find a way to divert these scouts?

choices.text: Take the Risk to Contact Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who noticed the truth of the feigned death, and now only she can provide insider intelligence. But contacting her means exposing his location.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the Risk of Being Tracked
choices.visible_reward: Obtain First-hand Intelligence from the Imperial Court
choices.risk_hint: If the Third Party Notices, the Situation Will Spiral Out of Control
choices.process_label: use secret transmission talisman to contact Su Qingyao

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip condensed a faint spiritual light, injecting it into the communication talisman at a special frequency. Three breaths later, the talisman burned away, and a cold female voice rang in his Mental Sea: "You dare contact me? Do you have any idea how chaotic it's become outside?!"

dialogue.content: The imperial court shadow guards have already intervened—they are investigating the truth of your feigned death. What's even more troublesome... that old fox Ling Yuan seems to be secretly pushing things along as well.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶主动提供皇朝内部情报

choices.text: Set Up Illusion Formation to Lead Scouts Astray
choices.description: Use the residual aura of the Tianji Record Fragment to lay multiple false trails, drawing the three factions' attention in different directions.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming the Tianji Record's aura may attract greater covetousness
choices.visible_reward: Buy More Time for Strategic Layout
choices.risk_hint: Once the Tianji Record's aura is locked onto, the troubles will be endless

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands,抽取 a wisp of aura from the Tianji Record Fragment, transforming it into three false trajectories dispersing in different directions. A slight smile curved his lips: "Want to catch me? First learn to tell真假." Moments later, the three auras outside the ancestral hall indeed began to diverge.

choices.text: Quietly Wait for the Opportunity and Observe the Visitors
choices.description: Do not take the initiative to strike, respond to changes with constancy, observe the three factions' purposes and mutual relationships, find escape opportunities from their weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best withdrawal timing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a More Complete Intelligence Network Map
choices.risk_hint: If all three factions close in simultaneously, retreat routes will be completely sealed off

text.content: Chen Ji收敛 all his aura, melding into the ancestral hall's shadows like a stubborn stone. The three auras gradually approached, he held his breath and focused, catching the conversation sounds from outside—he heard the Xuanwu Sect disciple asking the demonic path cultivator about "that waste's" whereabouts. The word 'waste' entering his ears, a cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes.

Outside the ancestral hall, footsteps drew closer. Through the gaps in the broken window lattice, Chen Ji saw a youth in Xuanwu Sect regulation armor looking around alertly. Han Lie's man—that arrogant face, he could recognize it even across the void. Farther away, a slender black shadow flickered between the tree shadows—it was someone from the Holy Sect of the demonic path.

A heavy feeling settled in Chen Ji's heart. The fluctuation of the time-space rift... came faster and more violently than anticipated. That power beyond the Heavenly Eye, where did it originate? Just then, the communication jade slip in his arms suddenly grew scalding hot—that was his agreed emergency contact method with Ye Qing. Why was the demonic path Saintess contacting him at this moment?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's emergency contact and the time-space rift anomaly occurred almost simultaneously, Chen Ji had to make a judgment within limited time.

choices.description: Intelligence from the Holy Sect of the demonic path often concerns the greater situation. Since Ye Qing used emergency contact, there must be important matters. Prioritize intelligence, then response.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to observe the three factions' movements
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Intelligence from the Demonic Path's Perspective
choices.risk_hint: The authenticity of Ye Qing's intelligence requires self-judgment

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, the Tianji Record's aura has gone out of control at the rift's edge! The Holy Sect Elder said that was not the power of the Heavenly Eye—it is something more ancient. It is... it is calling you.

choices.memory_label: 夜清预警：裂隙中有超越天道之眼的存在在呼唤陈机

choices.description: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value, foresee the movements of the three factions and further changes to the time-space rift within the next three hours.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -10, current remaining 310 points
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a Complete Three-Hour Prophecy Map
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is approaching the danger zone, use with caution!

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth dazzling golden light, Chen Ji's vision swam. Images emerged—the time-space rift would expand sharply in two hours, the Xuanwu Sect and demonic path cultivators would clash in the abandoned village, and he himself... was cornered at the back mountain of the ancestral hall by an unidentifiable black shadow. That black shadow's outline was strikingly similar to Chen Nian's description before her disappearance.

choices.memory_label: 预见显示：陈念可能与裂隙异变有关

text.content: The footsteps outside the ancestral hall suddenly stopped. That Xuanwu Sect disciple seemed to have sensed something, looking toward the ancestral hall's direction. Chen Ji immediately cut the communication,收敛 all his aura to the verge of nothingness. Mister Mo's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Little ghost, that imperial court shadow guard... left. But his aura clearly headed toward the Tianqing Sect direction—Ling Yuan that old thing, seems to have run out of patience."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan... that old fox. Chen Ji's gaze cooled, after feigned death what he feared most was not enemies attacking openly, but arrows from the shadows. He had originally planned to lie low with a new identity for half a month, waiting for the wind to settle before making further plans. Now it seemed, time did not wait for anyone.

text.content: Just then, a faint whooshing sound pierced through the broken window lattice of the ancestral hall. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was a regular flying knife with absolutely no spiritual energy fluctuation, and nailed to its tip was a yellowed paper note. The flying knife had sunk three fen into the wood, yet the paper note remained perfectly still—this level of control... the visitor was no ordinary person.

choice.prompt: The sudden appearance of the mysterious flying knife and paper note made Chen Ji realize a third force had entered this game of chess.

choices.text: Calmly Analyze the Paper Note's Content
choices.description: Since the visitor could deliver a message without leaving a trace, they must have some backing. Examine the content first, then judge.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into a psychological trap set by the other party
choices.visible_reward: Obtain First-hand Information from the Mysterious Force
choices.risk_hint: The other party seems to know Chen Ji's whereabouts like the palm of their hand
choices.process_label: carefully take and examine the note

text.content: After using divine sense to confirm it was non-toxic and unhexed, Chen Ji finally took down the paper note. Upon unfolding it, four characters struck the eye with shocking force—"Heavenly Eye Watches." The calligraphy was simple and vigorous, each stroke carrying an indescribable dao韵. The weight of these four characters made Chen Ji's back instantly soaked with cold sweat.

choices.description: Since the other party dared to come deliver a message, it means they are not afraid of Chen Ji's counterattack. Tracking the flying knife's origin might find clues to this mysterious force.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Other Party's Stronghold Intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The visitor's strength is深不可测, direct confrontation would be extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji followed the flying knife's trajectory out of the ancestral hall, searching with all his divine sense. However, within a hundred zhang in all directions, except for a few withered leaves that had been sliced off, there was no other abnormality. The visitor came and left without a trace, like a ghost. Mister Mo's voice sounded again, carrying unprecedented gravity: "This aura... resembles the Heavenly Eye, yet is not entirely it. It has been watching you, watching from the very beginning."

Night deepened, only wind and insect chirps remained in the abandoned village. Chen Ji stood atop the ancestral hall's ruined walls, the paper note in his hand fluttering noisily in the evening breeze. "Heavenly Eye Watches"—these four characters were like an invisible shackle, pinning him firmly onto the chessboard of fate. Mister Mo said the Heavenly Eye would truly manifest in Volume Eight, but these traces now... could everything have already been accelerated?

Chen Ji suddenly let out a low laugh. That laughter sounded especially eerie in the desolate night, yet it carried a desperate resolve to break all bridges. He tucked the paper note into his chest, turned, and vanished into the depths of night. Since the Heavenly Eye was already watching, then he would make this pair of eyes,，好好看看—how a waste overturns the entire chess game.

Three days later, at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. An ordinary-looking wandering cultivator youth submitted an entry application, his expression timid, his cultivation shallow, the disciple responsible for registration didn't even bother giving him a proper glance. The waste Chen Ji was dead; what lived on was merely a nameless nobody seeking a living in the Tianqing Sect. As for those forces secretly searching... let them search. What they would find, only a ghost they could never grasp.

The ink of those four characters had not yet dried, yet Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill climb from his tailbone to the back of his neck—someone was secretly watching him, and this person knew all his secrets.
